versions.content: If a packet shall be transmitted to a remote host and the link layer address does not exist in the Neighbor Cache, the TcpIp shall queue this packet according to IETF RFC 4861, section 7.2.2. Sending Neighbor Solicitations, 5th paragraph and transmit the packet when the address has been resolved.
